statement: In the Turin economy (seed 7), the family that ends up owning the city is decided within its first day, before its share of the cars says so: replays rewound to later hours of day 0 return the same winner far more often than replays from hour 0.
cmd: REPS=32 DAYS=4 EVERY=3 SPAN=24 node tools/replay.mjs turin 7 (then FREEZE=1)
predicted: hour 0: under 20% of replays; above 75% by hour 18; the rise comes before the family holds half the cars; frozen null similar to evolving
note: redesigned 2026-10-30 before any replay finished: the base run showed the winner already held 54% of the cars by the end of day 0, so days 1 and 5 were too late to rewind to
result: Turin s7, 32 replays per hour: evolving 0/32, 1/32, 15/32, 22/32 at hours 0, 3, 6, 9, then 32/32 from hour 12; frozen 0/32, 1/32, 21/32, 27/32, then 31-32/32. Decided between hours 3 and 12 of day 0, before the family holds half the cars (37-40% at hours 6-9). Not driven by evolution: with mutation frozen the winner is if anything surer (hours 6+9: 48/64 frozen vs 37/64 evolving, Fisher p=0.06). One seed; a second is next.

statement: An all-day congestion charge (0.1) cuts crashes per car and trip time and costs fares, in Turin.
predicted: fares -10 to -25%, crashes per car -15 to -25%, trip time -20 to -30%, all intervals excluding zero
result: 20 seeds (101-120), days 2-6: fares -17.8% [-20.5, -15.1], crashes per car -24.0% [-27.0, -21.0], trip time -29.0% [-30.6, -27.4], cars -44.8% [-47.1, -42.5], Gini +0.005 [+0.004, +0.006]; every seed the same direction. Within the predicted ranges.

statement: The decision window found for Turin seed 7 (the winner's replay win rate rising from near 0 at hour 3 to every replay by hour 12 of day 0) is not a quirk of that seed: on Turin seed 11 the winning family is also decided within day 0, before it holds half the cars.
cmd: REPS=32 DAYS=4 EVERY=3 SPAN=24 node tools/replay.mjs turin 11 (then FREEZE=1)
predicted: hour 0: under 20% of replays; above 75% by hour 12; the winner's share under 50% at the hour the rate passes 75%; frozen similar to evolving. If the curve is flat or only rises after day 0, the C1 result is seed-specific.
note: statement corrected 2026-10-30 before any seed 11 result: it first said 'decided by hour six', from a table that counted survival as winning; predictions unchanged
result: Killed. Correct counts (win = over half the cars), hours 0-21: evolving 3,7,12,11,19,9,16,15 of 32; frozen 6,3,8,9,8,3,26,27 of 32. Not decided on day 0 while evolving; frozen decides it from hour 18. An earlier version of this result counted survival as winning (corrected 2026-10-30).

statement: Insurance (crash costs pooled into a flat premium) roughly doubles crashes per car and raises fares, in Turin.
predicted: crashes per car +60 to +120%, fares up 10 to 40%, intervals excluding zero
source: README, Rules and prices: 'Insure drivers and they crash twice as often, and move a third more people'
result: 20 seeds, days 2-6: fares +34.3% [+31.5, +37.2], crashes per car +86.5% [+82.1, +91.1], trip time -35.8% [-37.4, -34.2], cars +65.4% [+59.5, +71.1], Gini +0.051 [+0.046, +0.055]; every seed the same direction. Within the predicted ranges; 'twice' is really +87%.

statement: Credit (a car may run 30 units into debt before it counts as broke) raises fares by a fifth to a quarter and crashes per car by about as much, in Turin.
predicted: fares +15 to +30%, crashes per car +15 to +30%, intervals excluding zero
source: README, Rules and prices: 'An overdraft raises fares by a fifth to a quarter and crashes as much' (the 30 is my guess at the original setting, from tools/policies.mjs)
result: fares +28.0% [+26.0,+29.7], crashes per car +25.2% [+22.4,+28.1], trip time +21.0% [+18.0,+24.0], cars +60.2%, Gini +0.291; all 20 seeds up. Predictions held; README 'a fifth to a quarter' was slightly low for fares.

statement: The Turin finding (a monopoly winner is mostly decided during day 0, replay win rate rising steeply over the first hours) also holds on another city: Barcelona, seed 7.
cmd: REPS=32 DAYS=4 EVERY=3 SPAN=24 node tools/replay.mjs barcelona 7 (then FREEZE=1)
predicted: hour 0: under 50% of replays; 75% or more by hour 12; frozen similar to evolving. If the curve is flat from hour 0 or only rises after day 0, the Turin result is a Turin quirk.
result: Barcelona s7, 32 replays per hour, evolving, same winner (family 59, 60% of the cars at the end): h0 1/32, h3 2/32, h6 13/32, h9 8/32, h12 13/32, h15 10/32, h18 14/32, h21 17/32 (h12: 26-58%, h21: 36-69%, Wilson 95%). Hour 0 under 50% as predicted, but 75% or more by hour 12 failed: the rate rises from near zero to about 40% by hour 6 and then stays at 25-53% through hour 21, with the winner holding 24-38% of the cars. On Barcelona the winner is only partly decided by day 0. Frozen run on hours 0, 6, 12, 21 launched, not part of this verdict.

statement: Mutation keeps the contest for the city open: replayed from the same moment, an economy with mutation frozen returns the original winner more often than one still evolving.
cmd: for s in 21 22 23 24 25 26: REPS=16 DAYS=4 EVERY=12 SPAN=24 node tools/replay.mjs turin $s 12 (and FREEZE=1)
predicted: pooled over six fresh Turin seeds, rewound to hour 12: frozen wins at least 10 percentage points more often than evolving, in at least 4 of 6 seeds; Fisher exact on the pooled counts p < 0.05
source: hint from C1 (seed 7, hours 6+9: 48/64 frozen vs 37/64) and C3 (seed 11, hours 18-21: 53/64 vs 31/64), both picked after the fact, hence fresh seeds
result: Turin hour 12, 16 replays per cell, winner replays (evolving vs frozen): s21 1 vs 1, s22 6 vs 2, s23 4 vs 1, s24 16 vs 16, s25 9 vs 7, s26 16 vs 16. Pooled 52/96 evolving, 43/96 frozen. Frozen never beat evolving, so 0 of 6 seeds met the +10 points bar; pooled Fisher exact two-sided p = 0.248. Direction is opposite to the prediction. C1 and C3 hints (seeds 7, 11) do not generalise to hour 12 on fresh seeds.

statement: A third city, Venice seed 7, behaves like Barcelona and Turin seed 11 rather than Turin seed 7: the original winner is not yet decided by hour 12 of day 0.
